title: WPSS/4312/2001 of PANKAJ KUMAR Vs STATE

paras.text:
W.P. No. 4312 of 01 (S/S)
Hon'ble P.C. Verma, J.
Heard learned counsel for the
petitioner.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
is not prepared. He could not even make
out a point for admission of the writ
petition therefore, the petition is
dismissed.
However, it is open to petitioner to
file a fresh writ petition.
6.9.2001 Sd/-
P.Singh
